links.outcome: PAF detection accuracy and clinician workload with clinician-AI collaboration versus clinician alone or AI alone
links.effect: Clinicians alone missed 13.7% of PAF patients; AI alone misidentified 23.3% of non-AF patients as PAF. Collaboration correctly identified all patients and reduced clinician workload by 76.7%.
links.quote: After implementing the proposed clinician-AI collaboration strategy, all patients were correctly identified, and clinicians' workload was reduced by 76.7%.

links.outcome: AI model diagnostic performance compared with clinicians on the same Holter data
links.effect: Clinicians alone overlooked 13.7% of PAF patients but identified all non-AF patients; AI rarely missed PAF but misidentified 23.3% of non-AF patients as PAF.
links.quote: Conversely, AI alone rarely missed PAF patients but misidentified 23.3% of non-AF patients as having PAF.

unlisted_practices: Using clinician diagnostic strengths and weaknesses to design a complementary AI model and a triage-style collaboration strategy
